title: A Bush Dinner Under the Stars
excerpt: A dinner in the bush, by lantern light and under the stars, is one of the most memorable evenings of a safari.
body:
Some camps and lodges organise dinners outside, in the bush or on a hill near camp.

## What to expect

A table with lanterns, a campfire, a chef cooking on the fire and the sounds of the night. Sometimes a sundowner first, watching the sun set over the plains.

## Where

Several camps in the Serengeti, Tarangire, Ngorongoro area and southern parks offer this.

## For whom

Couples, honeymooners and families celebrating a special occasion.

## Practical

Usually on request and depending on weather and safety. Bring a warm layer.

## Combine

With other [romantic safari experiences](/blog/romantic-safari-experiences/).

[Ask us about a bush dinner](/travel-proposal/).
